sourceFile: 04. L20S15-07 Report test new lot CD (4.21) ( IV 250417029)_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft misgroups the validation as a Lot 2 comparison instead of a new CD lot-use test across 10 lots and multiple checks.
issues: Changed factor incorrectly set to baseline vs Lot 2.
Most lot-level function and dyne results are omitted.
Bogus measurement outcome extracted from title/header rows.
Tension lot conditions are misparsed for rows after Lot 1.
correctionPlan: Define changed factor as new CD material lot/date IR250417029 including compensate lot context.
Keep Lot 1-10 as subgroup/test-lot results, not separate primary conditions.
Group dyne, tension, VP/CD separation, sigma, hearing, total NG, and NG rate under one validation case.
Reparse Tension rows with lot number/material/type and sample statistics, citing each row.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Citations exist but are not sufficient because key rows are misgrouped and some cited tension rows lack displayed source text.
